prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: final transparent title logo for the Portuguese browser management game DevTycoon.
Primary request: create one polished, distinctive retro pixel-art game title logo, matching a grounded 1990s isometric business tycoon game, NOT a startup company identity.
Text (verbatim): "DEV TYCOON". Spell D E V and T Y C O O N exactly. Two tightly stacked lines: smaller DEV above larger TYCOON, with strong readable custom block lettering. The entire name must be clear at 300px wide.
Composition: logo occupies almost all of a wide compact horizontal composition, approximately 2.2:1. A small, tastefully integrated open brick garage with a single old CRT coding monitor forms a compact emblem beside the left edge of the lettering. Architectural details are secondary to the wordmark. No characters. Nothing hidden behind the words.
Style: carefully authored native-resolution pixel art with crisp stepped edges, purposeful clusters of pixels, consistent pixel scale, dark graphite outlines and restrained hard-edged depth. Classic PC tycoon box-art lettering; mature and charming. Limited palette of warm ivory, aged ochre, dark graphite teal and small brick-brown accents. Flat pixel shading, restrained highlights. No smooth vector shapes, no glossy plastic, no AI fantasy detailing, no gradients, no glows, no lens flares, no bevel overload, no drop shadow outside the compact logo silhouette.
Background: truly transparent alpha, including all exterior negative space. The logo must work on a warm light parchment game menu. No background panel or scenery.
Constraints: only the requested DEV TYCOON wording, no tagline, no watermark, no extra text, no mockup or interface. Final usable standalone game logo asset.
